mcp.overview.agentFirst.body.message: mittwald MCP connects your AI coding assistant to mittwald's infrastructure. Describe what you want in natural language, and let your agent handle the API calls.

mcp.getStarted.learn.body.message: Human intent in prompts, MCP tools for execution, explicit approvals for risky actions.

mcp.workflow.body.message: Agent-driven workflows follow a consistent pattern: you provide intent, the agent discovers and executes tools, you verify results.

mcp.workflow.steps.intent.message: {bold} — You prompt the outcome you want on mittwald

mcp.workflow.steps.discovery.message: {bold} — Your agent discovers relevant MCP tools and required inputs

mcp.workflow.steps.auth.message: {bold} — OAuth or token auth is used for each tool call

mcp.workflow.steps.execution.message: {bold} — The agent performs tool calls and reports results

mcp.workflow.steps.verify.message: {bold} — You run read checks and decide whether to proceed, retry, or roll back

mcp.workflow.responsibility.message: {bold} Destructive or cost-impacting changes should be approved explicitly. Treat the agent as an operator, not as an unattended process.
